title: Penguin Slide
pitch: A penguin slides down an icy hill, dodging snowmen and grabbing fish, speeding up the longer it survives.
coreLoop: The penguin auto-slides down an endless icy hill; snowmen and fish come at it at increasing speed and spawn rate the longer the run lasts.
winLose: No win state: survive as long as possible. Touching a snowman ends the run.
scoring: +1 per second survived, +10 for each fish grabbed.
lookAndFeel: Cool blues and whites, icy gradient background, a snow trail behind the penguin, screen shake and an ice-shard burst on a snowman hit, a sparkle on fish pickup.
sound: A soft tick per score second, a cheerful blip on fish pickup, a crunchy thud on a snowman hit.

acceptance.text: Score increases while the player is alive (state().score).
Speed increases as time passes (state().speed rises with state().time).
Touching a snowman ends the run (state().scene === 'over').
Grabbing a fish increases state().score by 10 and removes that fish.
start() moves the scene from 'title' to 'playing' and resets score to 0.

changes.summary: Hugging the right wall let the penguin dodge every snowman. Obstacles now spawn across the full width and the penguin stops a little short of the edge.

acceptance.text: Holding ArrowRight against the wall for 30 s still ends the run (state().scene === 'over').
